entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4287820848378092672: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.6895 +/- 0.0143 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 213.24 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -3.360, -11.101 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.906 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract). Mass 0.96 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract). Temperature 5625 +/- 120 K from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,625 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffefe5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,625 K and log g 4.51 (u1 0.493, u2 0.238): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
